interface.longDescription:
Discover inspiration and create images and videos with the latest AI models. Bring your favorites, boards, and past creations into the conversation.

Explore up to six visual inspirations at a time, browse another batch, and read a selected prompt. Compare available models and current prices, then create images or videos. You can also remove or replace backgrounds, upscale images, and create marketing posters or product-detail images.

With your permission, search your MeiGen favorites, boards, and creation history to find references and revisit original prompts. Reading your library and saving favorites require separate account permissions. Save a selected inspiration or your own creation when you ask or click Save; images from one generation are saved together. Saving does not publish your creation. Your saved references can guide a relevant creative request; the plugin does not create a separate preference profile.

Connect a verified MeiGen account to use paid tools. Generations use your existing purchased credits; daily free credits do not apply. Review the current price and requested image count before starting. MeiGen does not sell credits or subscriptions through this plugin.

With your permission, prepare a selected image attachment or direct public image URL. Prepared images receive public links accessible to anyone who has the link and are scheduled for cleanup seven days after their latest upload. Accepted generations retain separate reference copies for history and reuse; contact support for removal. Storage cleanup does not guarantee immediate removal of cached copies. Uploads are not automatically published to the gallery.

Recover an existing task after a timeout without starting another generation, and revoke access from MeiGen's Connected apps page. Image previews depend on the host; original result links remain available.
defaultPrompt: Find six product photography inspirations and show their previews.
Help me create an image or video. Show suitable models and the cost before generating.
Find relevant favorites or past creations in my MeiGen account and help me reuse a selected prompt.
